title: Colour grade before and after on the talking-head edit
caption: The warm-vibrant grade preset on the talking-head edit, shown as a split screen: the left half is the source, the right half the graded file, so the extra contrast, saturation and warmth are visible on the same frame.
prompt: Grade 7 seconds of ../videos/03-talking-head-edit.mp4 (from 2 s to 9 s) with the warm-vibrant preset, so it feels warmer and punchier for a promo. Then make a before/after split for the client: left half the original, right half the graded clip, a thin cream divider in the middle and small "Before" and "After: warm-vibrant" labels in Geist from fonts/ (labels.svg). Keep the audio.
commands: ffmpeg -i work/source.mp4 -i work/graded.mp4 -i work/labels.png -filter_complex "[0:v]crop=960:1080:0:0[l];[1:v]crop=960:1080:960:0[r];[l][r]hstack=inputs=2,drawbox=x=958:y=0:w=4:h=1080:color=0xf0eadf:t=fill[c];[c][2:v]overlay=0:0,format=yuv420p[v]" -map [v] -map 1:a -c:v libx264 -crf 16 -preset medium -c:a aac -b:a 160k work/compare.mp4
